result.edit: The test fails at cycle=3 with gray code 0010 when expecting 0011. The issue is in the Gray-to-binary conversion where bin_out[3] uses blocking assignment (=) while other bits use non-blocking (<=). This inconsistency causes incorrect intermediate values during calculation. Changing bin_out[3] to non-blocking assignment ensures proper sequential behavior, fixing the Gray code sequence generation while preserving the reset and hold behavior.
